_note: Spec §10.3: same 8 pillars and 12 questions, adapted for utilities. Answers score 0–3. referenceDefaults is the synthetic reference Utility's answers; the cohort band is an anonymised synthetic Utility cohort.

questions.text: Are AI use cases tied to outcomes with baselines (SAIDI, O&M per customer, bad debt, safety)?
How accurate is the GIS network model (customer-to-transformer and phase connectivity)?
Is AMI interval data validated, complete and available within hours?
Is there a governed route for OT data (SCADA, historian, EMS) into analytics, one way across security zones?
Does consent for customer energy usage data propagate to every system, partner and agent?
Is critical-infrastructure information (CEII, BES Cyber System Information) classified and handled by policy?
Do IEEE 1366 reliability metrics have one certified definition and full lineage?
Has the BI estate been rationalised, with KPI lineage and stewards?
Can agents call catalogued, reversible actions in IT systems (CIS, OMS, EAM, work management)?
Is there an evidence trail for every agent action, approval and refusal?
Are agents evaluated before promotion, with approvers named and the OT cap enforced?
How automated are control-room and field processes (dispatch, switching preparation, work planning)?

blockers.noOtRoute: No governed route for OT data into analytics
blockers.noConsent: No consent propagation for customer energy usage data
blockers.noEvidence: No evidence trail for agent actions
